routes.name: Visa exemption for tourism (A1)
routes.summary: Indonesia has a tourism visa exemption (code A1) for some nationalities, such as ASEAN citizens. We could not read the official page with the country list or day limits.

other: The official country list is on the Immigration site under the VoA, visa-free and calling visa list. We could not open it, so check your passport there. Day limits not confirmed.

routes.name: Visa on Arrival (B1)
routes.summary: Citizens of listed countries get a 30 day tourist visa on arrival for IDR 500,000. You can extend once for another 30 days.

other: Only for nationalities on the official VoA list.
Passport valid at least 6 months and a return or onward ticket.
Allowed: travel, visiting family or friends, meetings and conventions, transit.
You may not sell goods or services or get paid by anyone in Indonesia.

stay.note: One extension of 30 days. The visa itself is valid 90 days from issue.

steps: Check your passport is on the official VoA list.
Pay at the bank counter at the airport inspection area, or get an e-VoA online before you fly.
Show the voucher at the VoA counter.
To extend, apply at the immigration office near where you stay, or online for e-VoA.

routes.name: Electronic Visa on Arrival (e-VoA)
routes.summary: Apply online before you fly for the same B1 visa on arrival. Pay by card and the e-VoA is emailed within about 1 day.

other: Same nationalities as VoA.
Passport biodata page valid at least 6 months, a recent color photo, and a return or onward ticket.

steps: Pay by debit or credit card.
Get the e-VoA by email, usually within 1x24 hours.
routes.processing: E-VoA emailed within 1x24 hours, per the visa page

routes.name: Visit visa (C and D series, eVisa)
routes.summary: If you aren't visa-free or VoA eligible, you apply online for a single-entry (C) or multiple-entry (D) visit visa. There are separate codes for tourism, business, medical, media, content creator, events, internships and more.

other: Visa codes include C1 tourism, C2 business, C5A content creator, D1 and D2 multiple-entry. We could not read the individual fee and requirement pages.

routes.name: Visit stay permit extension
routes.summary: You can extend a visit stay permit in country. Most single-entry visit visas start at 60 days and can reach 180 days in total.

other: File no earlier than 14 days before expiry and no later than the expiry date.
Need a valid passport, a sponsor letter if a sponsor was used, and a statement of purpose.
Pre-investment and internship visas can reach 12 months. VoA (index B) is 30 days plus one 30 day extension. Index F is 7 days and can't be extended.

stay.note: Single-entry C visas: 60 days start, up to 180 days total. Prospective worker C18: up to 120 days total.

routes.processing: Up to 3 working days after payment (up to 5 for calling visa countries)

routes.name: Remote Worker Visa (E33G)
routes.summary: Up to 1 year of residence for people employed by a company outside Indonesia. You need to show at least USD 60,000 a year in income. No sponsor needed.

income.note: Shown by bank records of salary or other income

other: Employment agreement with a company established outside Indonesia.
Bank statements for the last 3 months showing at least USD 2,000.
Passport valid at least 6 months, recent photo, CV, itinerary.
You can't work beyond the permit scope or sell goods or services in Indonesia.

stay.note: Extend online. The visa must be used within 90 days of issue.

steps: Upload passport, bank statements, income proof, employment agreement, photo, CV and itinerary.
Pay the visa fee and wait for approval.
routes.processing: 5 working days after payment, per the visa page

routes.name: Second Home Visa for retirees 55+ (E33E)
routes.summary: A 5 year residence visa for people aged 55 or older. You need USD 50,000 kept in a state bank and proof of pension or income.

savings.note: Keep in a personal account at a state-owned bank. Report proof to immigration within 90 days of entry.

other: Bank statement showing at least USD 2,000 over the last 3 months.
Immigration guarantee (Jaminan Keimigrasian), no sponsor needed.
Passport valid at least 6 months, photo, CV, travel history, itinerary.
No working outside the permit scope.

routes.name: Golden Visa, investor setting up a company (E28B)
routes.summary: A 5 or 10 year residence visa for individual investors who will set up an Indonesian company. No sponsor needed.

investment.note: 5-year visa. USD 5,000,000 for the 10-year visa. Must be met within 90 days of entering Indonesia.

other: Proof of shares in a foreign company and its sales, from audited statements by an internationally recognized accounting firm.
Written commitment to set up an Indonesian company with the required investment.
Bank statement showing at least USD 2,000. Passport valid at least 6 months.

stay.note: 5 or 10 years. Can be extended or converted.

routes.name: Golden Visa, investment without a company
routes.summary: Immigration's 2023 announcement says investors who don't set up a company can get 5 or 10 years by placing USD 350,000 or USD 700,000 in government bonds, listed shares or deposits. We could not read the visa page for current rules.

investment.note: 5-year stay. USD 700,000 for 10 years. From a 2023 announcement, not confirmed on the visa page.

other: Confirm current amounts and eligible instruments on the official site before applying.

sources.label: Immigration: Golden Visa legal basis announcement

routes.name: Investor Visa (E28A)
routes.summary: A 1 or 2 year residence visa for foreign investors who hold at least IDR 10 billion in shares of an Indonesian company. A sponsor is needed.

investment.note: Minimum shareholding in the sponsoring company, which must be registered with the Ministry of Investment/BKPM

other: Sponsor company needed.
Bank statement showing at least USD 2,000.
If your shareholding is lower but you are a director or commissioner, apply for the matching work visa instead.

routes.name: Work visas and work ITAS (E23, E24, E25 series)
routes.summary: Work visas are tied to a sponsor and a role (general work, director, manager, researcher, digital sector expert and more). The first permit is 180 days, 1 year or 2 years.

other: Work visa ITAS extensions can't be longer than the first grant, and total ITAS can't exceed 6 years.
We could not read the requirement pages for the general work visa. Check the official site for the role you need.

routes.name: Researcher Work Visa (E29)
routes.summary: A 1 year work visa for research projects. You need a research institution sponsor and a permit from BRIN.

other: Sponsor letter from a research institution.
Permit from BRIN, the National Research and Innovation Agency.
Bank statement showing at least USD 2,000. Passport valid at least 6 months.

routes.name: Higher Education Student Visa (E30B)
routes.summary: Study visas come in 1 or 2 year options. Requirements weren't listed on the page we could read.

other: Requirements not shown on the visa page. Confirm with the university and Immigration.

routes.name: Spouse Family Visa (E31A and E31B)
routes.summary: Foreign spouses of Indonesian citizens or of ITAS/ITAP holders can get a 1 or 2 year family visa. A sponsor is needed.

other: Marriage proof and a letter from the Indonesian spouse.
Bank statement showing at least USD 2,000.
The E31B page mixes citizen and ITAS/ITAP spouse wording. Confirm which applies to you.

routes.name: Family Visa for child of an Indonesian parent (E31F)
routes.summary: A 1 or 2 year visa for foreign children of an Indonesian citizen parent. A court ruling must prove the parent and child link.

other: Indonesian court ruling on the legal relationship and the parent's family card.
Bank statement showing at least USD 2,000. The page gives no formal eligibility rules.

routes.name: Global Citizen of Indonesia, special expertise (E32F)
routes.summary: For former Indonesian citizens with special expertise who are sponsored by the central government and want to settle in Indonesia.

other: Sponsorship from the central government and proof of former Indonesian citizenship.
Not open to people who worked abroad in civil service, law enforcement, intelligence or military roles, or were involved in separatist groups.
Page gives no duration or fee.

routes.name: Working holiday visa (E35)
routes.summary: Indonesia lists a working holiday visa (E35), with an Australia version (E35A). The page shows 'data not available', so rules are unconfirmed.

other: Age limits, fees and other partner countries not confirmed.

routes.name: Permanent stay permit (ITAP)
routes.summary: Holders of ITAS for work, clergy, investment, family, repatriation or second home can convert to ITAP. It's granted for 5 years and can be extended with no limit.

other: The page doesn't say how many years of ITAS you need first. Check with Immigration.
Also open without conversion to some former Indonesian citizens and children born in Indonesia to ITAP holders.
Integration statement needed. Holders of unlimited ITAP report every 5 years.

routes.name: Indonesian citizenship (naturalization)
routes.summary: Citizenship by naturalization is handled by the Ministry of Law. The official pages we could open gave no years, language rules or dual citizenship details.

other: Years of residence, language test and dual citizenship rules not confirmed. Check the Ministry of Law and Immigration sites.
